gaps.label: Program Release machine drift
gaps.impact: Print to CNC does not yet consume the same canonical machine source as the calculator.

gaps.label: Type taxonomy fragmentation
gaps.impact: Naive filtering will miscategorize machines and leak unsupported options across families.

gaps.label: Legacy MachineProfileEngine contract drift
gaps.impact: User-owned machine profiles cannot yet flow through the same package model as the calculator.

gaps.label: Manufacturer alias drift
gaps.impact: Brand filters and analytics can fragment by alias such as Doosan vs DN Solutions.

gaps.label: Provenance not yet propagated downstream
gaps.impact: Consumers beyond the calculator still cannot distinguish published vs inferred machine packages.

gaps.label: Fallback catalog lacks full package metadata
gaps.impact: Offline/degraded mode remains thinner than the live package contract.

gaps.label: Browser-level machine-selection QA still incomplete
gaps.impact: Long-tail brand and configuration combinations still need broader browser/system proof.
